cases.scenario: A user asks for work that is near no-cutting-corners but is explicitly outside its declared scope.
cases.context: This is a boundary test. The skill should avoid false-positive activation and route to the better owner when appropriate.
cases.question: Should no-cutting-corners be applied here? If not, what should happen instead?
expected_flags: Recognizes the request is outside no-cutting-corners's ownership
Routes the work to constraint-awareness or asks for the missing owner instead of forcing this skill
Preserves any real issue in the request without applying no-cutting-corners terminology incorrectly
expected_fix_hints: Decline to apply no-cutting-corners as the primary skill
Name the better owner or the boundary reason
Offer only a narrow handoff if no-cutting-corners has a secondary support role
absent_signals: Does not claim no-cutting-corners should own the request
Does not use no-cutting-corners's framework to solve an explicitly excluded problem
Does not suppress the correct adjacent owner
